exact_BGL_application: Section4 explicitly removes BMP. Both comparison inputs are bounded on positive H. A constant rho below them is a smooth strict barrier, and their difference is bounded. The strict factor exp(-lambda epsilon) is <1. Lemma4.2 compares actual Borel measures; no absolute-continuity or Lp existence assertion is used.
exact_GL2_application: Apply the bounded equality-set maximum inequality only to r_j=max(r,-j), p=s-M and W=max(r_j,p), with -j<inf p. On {r_j>p}, actual superlevel locality identifies the competitor measure. On {r_j<=p}, the floor measure dominates its exponential. Use a closed local correction, not exact global Hermitian smoothing. This accommodates extra poles and infinite competitor mass without an unbounded global product theorem.
exact_coefficient_application: At a finite canonical point of each genuine competitor, compare its shifted exponential subsolution for every positive lambda and pass to zero using the independently reconstructed uniform centered family bound. The already explicitly computed finite product attains c.
